productLines.desc: When you join Epicare you get access to the three core insurance categories — each backed by the right carriers.
productLines.cat1_desc: Protection for what matters most — from term coverage to permanent policies and final expense.
productLines.cat2_desc: Medical plans for every stage and budget, including the Marketplace and Medicare.
productLines.cat3_desc: Coverage that fills the gaps: dental, vision, and protection against the unexpected.
cat1_descs: Affordable coverage for a set period — ideal for protecting income and family.
Permanent protection that builds cash value over your lifetime.
A small whole-life policy that covers funeral and end-of-life costs.
cat2_descs: Temporary medical coverage that bridges the gap between plans.
Comprehensive health coverage for both everyday and serious care.
Subsidy-eligible plans offered through the federal Marketplace.
All-in-one Medicare with built-in prescription drug coverage.
cat3_descs: Preventive and restorative dental care coverage.
Coverage for exams, lenses, and frames.
Cash benefits for injuries from covered accidents.
Financial protection that pays out on a cancer diagnosis.
Fixed cash payments for every covered hospital stay.
A lump-sum benefit for major events like stroke or heart attack.
Fills the coverage gaps left by Original Medicare.

whyEpicare.subtitle: There are hundreds of agencies in the market. The difference isn't in the carriers we offer — it's in how we build the infrastructure so you can produce more.
whyEpicare.pillar1Desc: 5 years of active operation, 6,000+ insured and 100+ agents. You join something that already works — not an experiment.
whyEpicare.pillar2Desc: GO AMS gives you visibility of your business in real-time. Never again depend on late reports or data you can't see.
whyEpicare.pillar3Desc: By contracting with Epicare you get access to the full portfolio. You don't need to negotiate separate contracts with each carrier.
whyEpicare.pillar4Desc: Support with real SLAs, contracting, commissions, and compliance teams. When something fails, someone resolves it.
